bio.text: Mike Halpin has represented the 36th District in the Illinois Senate since 2023.
He is an attorney with a B.A. from Roger Williams University and a J.D. from the University of Illinois.
According to the legislature biography, he was a legislative aide to former Congressman Lane Evans and a former public guardian for Rock Island County, and he lives in Rock Island.

sources.title: Michael W. Halpin - Member Biography, 104th General Assembly
